introduction_markdown: General Certificate of Education (GCE) Board, Ordinary Level, June 2021. Additional Mathematics, Paper 2 (code 0575). Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions in SECTION A (Pure Mathematics, compulsory) and ANY TWO questions from EITHER SECTION B (Mechanics) or SECTION C (Statistics and Probability). In Sections B and C, all questions carry equal marks. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C, but NOT a combination of all three. If Section B is chosen, Section C may not be chosen, and the other way round. All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators may be used. Where necessary take g as 10 m s^-2. Formulae booklets may be used.

- She must use at least 2 cups of beans and at least 4 cups of corn.
- The quantity of corn she uses must be greater than or equal to the quantity of beans.

Points : le sujet imprime des points par sous-question, pas de total par question. Le champ points de chaque exercice est la somme des points imprimes des sous-questions (Section A : 8 ou 9 ; Sections B et C : 17, ce qui est coherent avec « all questions carry equal marks »).

Q5 : le sujet dit que la quantite de haricots et de mais « is 20 cups » ; lu comme un total d'au plus 20 tasses ($x+y\le20$), ce qui donne une region et quatre inegalites. Avec $x+y=20$ exactement, la depense maximale resterait 1 500 francs (au point (10, 10)). Les graphiques (b) sont a tracer par le candidat : decrits dans le corrige (sommets et echelle).

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) Write down four inequalities in terms of $x$ and $y$ that satisfy these conditions. *[3 marks]*
(b) On a graph paper, taking 1 cm for 2 units on both axes, shade so as to leave unshaded the region represented by these inequalities. *[3 marks]*
(c) Given that a cup of beans costs 100 francs and a cup of corn costs 50 francs, find the maximum expenditure that can be incurred by the woman. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The cost is $C=100x+50y$. Its maximum over the region occurs at a vertex:

| Vertex | $C=100x+50y$ |
|---|---|
| $(2,4)$ | $400$ |
| $(4,4)$ | $600$ |
| $(10,10)$ | $1500$ |
| $(2,18)$ | $1100$ |

The maximum is at $(10,10)$: $C=100(10)+50(10)=1500$.

**The maximum expenditure is 1,500 francs** (10 cups of beans and 10 cups of corn).
